auditor.label: Audit chrome ru
auditor.model_note: Model selector as reported by the harness for this session; the resolved provider model id is not exposed to this subagent and is not guessed.
auditor.independence: Did not read translator reports, ledger entries or other auditors' notes. Compared en source, en context sidecar, ru target bytes, i18n/glossary.md, i18n/style-guides/ru.md and existing ru catalogues only. Repo not edited.

relay.chrome.row.verdict: PASS (1 minor F4; 1 nit F2 mark_read)

verdicts.overall: PASS — no blocker or major finding; 2 minor + 3 nit (all non-gating)

findings.proposed: No change required; if O1 is meant to override legacy casing, Вкл / Выкл (3 and 4 cells, within maxCells 6); record the short pair in i18n/style-guides/ru.md
findings.reason: Lowercase matches the locale's shipped short state pair (tui.tags.on/off and tui.schedule.value_on/off already use вкл / выкл); the only tension is the sidecar's sentence-case tone. The abbreviation is forced by maxCells 6 (включено/отключено are 8/10 cells).

findings.proposed: Keep Прочитать / Прочитать все (consistent pair; a literal marking phrase cannot fit the 20-cell mark_all budget: «Отметить прочитанными» is 21 cells). If literal sense is required: «Отметить как прочитанное» (24 cells <= 28) on the row plus a shortened header, accepting verb drift.
findings.reason: English marks as read without opening; all six other translated locales keep the marking verb. «Прочитать» is an established Russian messaging shorthand for this control, so ru is the only locale dropping the marking sense — noted, not worth churning the pair.

findings.current: Продолжить / Продолжаем… (button word referenced in ended_hint)
findings.proposed: Either Возобновить / Возобновляем… (aligning with wire.slash.resume and tui.notices), or keep Продолжить and record it as the ru UI term for Resume
findings.reason: Same English term 'Resume' maps to возобновить elsewhere in ru (wire.slash.resume, wire.slash.archive, tui.notices) and to продолжить in this namespace; both are correct Russian, so this is drift, not a comprehension failure.

для governs the genitive, so a verbatim Russian conversation name in the nominative reads ungrammatical when the accessible name is spoken; the colon form is already used in this namespace (Рабочая папка: {name}) and in relay.approvals (Одобрения: {mode}).

Renders at exactly the 16-cell budget with a 2-digit count (en is 11) and a 3-digit count overflows; the adverbial form also differs from the locale's adjective Непрочитанные in wire.slash.notifications. Width signal, not a semantic defect.
